preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) >= 1 and len(S) <= 10000 for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]])
preconditions.description: Each test case string S has length between 1 and 10000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(S.count('W') == 1 for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]])
preconditions.description: Each test case string S contains exactly one 'W' character.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in {'B', 'W'} for c in S) for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]])
preconditions.description: Each test case string S consists only of 'B' and 'W' characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().splitlines() == [('Chef' if (left_blacks == 0 and right_blacks == 0) or (left_blacks > 0 and right_blacks > 0) else 'Aleksa') for S in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]]]
postconditions.description: For each test case, output 'Chef' if the game is a losing position for Aleksa (i.e., no moves possible or both sides have black cells, making it a losing position for the first player), otherwise output 'Aleksa'. The losing position is determined by the XOR of the number of black cells on the left and right of 'W' being zero.
